mapper.select: SELECT id, plan_no AS "planNo", algorithm, status, optimization_factor AS "optimizationFactor", max_iterations_running AS "maxIterationsRunning", iteration_delay_sec AS "iterationDelaySec", external_id AS "externalId", scheduled_start AS "scheduledStart", created_at AS "createdAt" FROM schedule_plan WHERE tenant_id = #{t} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, plan_no AS "planNo", algorithm, status, objective, horizon, metrics, input_snapshot AS "inputSnapshot", optimization_factor AS "optimizationFactor", max_iterations_running AS "maxIterationsRunning", iteration_delay_sec AS "iterationDelaySec", external_id AS "externalId", scheduled_start AS "scheduledStart" FROM schedule_plan WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule_plan (tenant_id, plan_no, algorithm, status, optimization_factor, max_iterations_running, iteration_delay_sec, external_id, scheduled_start) VALUES (#{t}, #{planNo}, #{algorithm}, #{status}, #{optimizationFactor}, #{maxIterationsRunning}, #{iterationDelaySec}, #{externalId}, #{scheduledStart}::timestamptz)
mapper.select: SELECT rb.id, rb.resource_id AS "resourceId", rn.code AS "resourceCode", lower(rb.period) AS "periodFrom", upper(rb.period) AS "periodTo", rb.status::text AS "status", rb.source_type AS "sourceType", rb.source_id AS "sourceId", rb.run_node_id AS "runNodeId", rb.note FROM resource_booking rb LEFT JOIN resource_node rn ON rn.id = rb.resource_id WHERE rb.tenant_id = #{t} AND rb.deleted_at IS NULL AND rb.source_id = #{runId} ORDER BY rb.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resource_booking (tenant_id, resource_id, period, status, source_type, source_id, run_node_id, note) VALUES (#{t}, #{resourceId}, tstzrange(#{periodLower}::timestamptz, #{periodUpper}::timestamptz, '[)'), #{status}::booking_status, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{runNodeId}, #{note})
